comparison.objective: Clip an electronic lead and safely capture its offcut; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block without losing balls.
comparison.physical_skill: Record coordinates nippers with offcut holding and disposal. Candidate aligns and butts a jig to a rail while sliding and regrasping the bearing block.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a flush cut, controlled offcut, cup disposal and no dangerous flight. Candidate requires complete block transfer, continuous support and retention of every ball.
comparison.reason: Both penalize loss of a small part, but one tests tool cutting and active offcut capture; the other tests uninterrupted raceway support during precision transfer.
